title: Concept: Ambient type package ships into the runtime dependency set
description: package.json declares a `@types/*` package declared as a runtime dependency, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `@types/*` package declared as a runtime dependency.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `@types/*` package declared as a runtime dependency.
